# Spline Interpolant

[All examples](index.md) · [Document profile](../reference/studio-draft-examples.md)

With x = \[0, 1, 2\], y = \[0, 1, 8\], initial_boundary = 0, final_boundary = 12, Run displays interpolant = \[0, 6, 12\], error = 0.

## What this example demonstrates

With x = \[0, 1, 2\], y = \[0, 1, 8\], initial_boundary = 0, final_boundary = 12, Run displays interpolant = \[0, 6, 12\], error = 0.
